_doc: [home] Homeward: the campaign across the Verdance system (systems/homeward.gd). Five fixed planets in order (profile worlds; planet 0 = Verdance = world 0). A planet's restoration (0..1): Verdance = its Bloom Core charge (100% when the Cradle answers); other planets = w_thriving * min(1, thriving hexes / thriving) + w_bases * min(1, bases at level 5 / bases) + w_start * min(1, start-district Thriving share / start_ratio). It never drops (best value kept in the profile). System restoration = mean over the five. A restored planet (100%) gives its relic and one Heirloom pick. Drive tiers (Mk V-VII) are the rocket's interplanetary drive, kept in the profile and carried to every planet: a planet needs drive >= nav and its chart (the previous planet at chart_at). Mk VII needs every relic, the whole system restored and Lumi at Verdance's Cradle Returns. Costs: cubes and parts.

planets.name: Verdance
planets.twist: Home. The Makers' world, buried under the Ledger's leavings. Restore it to the Cradle Returns pad.

planets.name: Ochre
planets.twist: The Ledger's first strip mine: open pits and slag dunes. Rich salvage, steady wind, very little water.

planets.name: Tidewell
planets.twist: An ocean the dredgers drained of minerals. Towns on islands, rain every hour, life desperate to come back.

planets.name: Rime
planets.twist: A moon core-mined until its heat ran out and it froze. Long nights, thin soil, lakes under the ice.

planets.name: Anvil
planets.twist: The Ledger's foundry world and head office. Pole-to-pole rust, the heaviest scrap in the system, and a hollow core.

ochre_glass.name: Ochre Sun-Glass
ochre_glass.desc: Slag fused clear by the dune winds. It holds a little of Ochre's light.

tidewell_pearl.name: Tidewell Pearl
tidewell_pearl.desc: The first pearl grown in Tidewell's sea in two hundred years.

rime_core.name: Rime Heart-Ice
rime_core.desc: A core sample from the thawed lakes, still faintly warm.

anvil_ingot.name: Anvil Ingot
anvil_ingot.desc: The Ledger's last ingot, recast as a plain ring with a seed stamped in it.

drive.name: Mk V Orbital
drive.desc: A vacuum-rated hull and a sun-sail: reaches the near planets, Ochre and Tidewell.

drive.name: Mk VI Interplanetary
drive.desc: A fold drive salvaged from a Ledger ore hauler: reaches Rime and Anvil.

drive.name: Mk VII Homeward
drive.desc: A great green-light rocket on a launch complex built from every planet you saved. One trip: up to the Cradle.
